title: Improve selected Task detail density and edit form hierarchy
description:
Problem: the live selected-task review showed the `/tasks` detail area getting squeezed below a tall filter bar and short results list. In the selected task pane, status/priority chips, tag chips, the edit icon, and form fields compete for the same vertical space, and labels can visually crowd nearby metadata.

Desired outcome: when a task is selected, the detail pane should prioritize the task title, status, key metadata, description, and comments without making the user fight nested scrolling or crowded form chrome.

Scope:
- In scope: selected-task detail layout, metadata/chip grouping, edit/view mode hierarchy, list/detail split behavior, and clearer affordances for collapse/focus.
- Out of scope: changing task JSON schema or task persistence semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Selecting a task gives the detail pane enough room to read the description and comments on narrow viewports.
- Metadata chips and form labels do not overlap or crowd each other.
- The edit action and edit fields have a clear hierarchy distinct from read-only metadata.
- Collapsing the task list or entering a focused detail mode is discoverable.

Validation:
- Capture `/tasks` before/after with a selected task in read and edit states.
- Run focused browser checks for selecting a task, toggling the list, editing fields, and saving/canceling without layout regressions.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 deeper live review: selected `/tasks` detail showed a cramped detail form, short list/detail split, and crowded metadata/field hierarchy.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by restructuring the selected-task pane around a dedicated summary block, moving the focus-detail toggle out of the overlapping header area, separating read-only metadata from edit sections, and shrinking the narrow list/detail split so the detail pane keeps more reading room. Validation: `dotnet test .\MemorySmith.Tests\MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "TasksMarkup_PrioritizesSelectedTaskSummaryAndFocusAction"` passed 1/1. Browser validation in sandbox `artifacts/browser-validation/tsk-0131/20260526-121442-42ee26e26/` at `http://127.0.0.1:5119/tasks` confirmed `TSK-0131` rendered clean selected, focused, and edit states on a narrow viewport with a clickable focus/show-list control and no status-control overlap. Screenshots: `tasks-detail-narrow-selected.png`, `tasks-detail-narrow-focused.png`, `tasks-detail-narrow-edit.png`, `tasks-detail-desktop.png`.
